snippet.title: TRENCHWORMS - Official Gameplay Trailer | Destructible Terrain & Online Multiplayer
snippet.description:
TRENCHWORMS is a fast-paced 2D action game inspired by classics like Liero and Worms.

💥 Fully destructible terrain
🔫 26 unique weapons
🪱 Ninja-rope movement
🌐 Online multiplayer
🎮 Couch co-op
🤖 Single-player campaign & AI battles
🔥 Sudden-death lava

Dig through the terrain, swing across the battlefield, grab weapons and blow your opponents to pieces.

Wishlist TRENCHWORMS on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5161820/TRENCHWORMS/

Developed by Walus Game Studio.
